## Checklist

- [ ] Fits `docs/SCOPE.md`; linked issue is `accepted` (or the change is a small fix)
- [ ] One topic; no unrelated changes
- [ ] Tests added or updated; they fail without this change
- [ ] Docs, examples and `CHANGELOG.md` (`[Unreleased]`, written for users) updated
- [ ] ADR added or updated in `docs/adr/`, or not needed (see `AGENTS.md`)
- [ ] Fast check passes; full check passes where the change can affect it
- [ ] No secrets, personal data or generated files
- [ ] Breaking change or hardware claim: called out above, with evidence and upgrade notes
